//: Test sources sit beside the modules they cover, so every package's
`include: src/**/*.ts` would otherwise compile them into `dist/` and make
the product build depend on the test adapter under `test/`. Excluding them
here reaches every package because none declares its own `exclude`, and an
inherited one applies wherever the deriving config does not replace it.
The tests are still type-checked: `tsconfig.tests.json` at the root owns
exactly the files this drops, and `pnpm typecheck` runs it.
